metaDescription: Sites, business applications and SaaS, remotely, from Niterói.
tagline: Websites and applications, remotely, from Niterói.

hero.lead: For a company that needs a website, a working tool, or an online product. Conversations in Portuguese, French, English and Spanish.

items.title: Brochure site
items.text: A clear site to present a business and receive messages. A few pages, readable on a phone, with a way to get in touch. Rebuilding a site that is already online is part of this.

items.title: Business application
items.text: A tool that follows how you work: client area, dashboard, bookings or tracking. The quote starts from the need, not from a page count.

items.title: SaaS
items.text: Launch a product: accounts, subscriptions, payment and administration. First a version people can use, then it grows.

items.title: Care
items.text: After launch: backups, updates, fixes and small changes. A monthly plan, with no long commitment.

items.title: Scope
items.text: We clarify the need, the people it is for, and what must be online first.

items.title: Quote
items.text: A written scope, a timeline and a price, before the work starts.

items.title: Build
items.text: The work moves in visible steps. You review it as it grows.

items.title: Delivery
items.text: Launch, access, and what comes next if you want ongoing care.

presence.title: Presence
presence.text: The work is remote. Mornings overlap with the US East Coast. Afternoons overlap with Europe.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Describe the project. The message opens in WhatsApp, ready to send.
